architectureDecisions: D1 — The supported v1 distribution is one single-tenant OCI/container profile with a CLI-first control surface. Kubernetes tenancy, multi-node HA and an operator web UI are explicitly deferred; they require separate measured product need.

D2 — DELIVERY_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 is the normative distribution identity. It binds source/release version, linux/amd64 image content ID, required delivery-image.tar SHA-256, pinned Node-24 base-image identity, state-schema compatibility version, SCM=GitHub, delivered runtime/profile refs, config-schema digest and reference-seed digest. A Docker tag is only a local locator and can never satisfy identity/currentness by itself.

D3 — The supported v1 runtime is linux/amd64 Node 24. The Worker resolves the selected official Node 24 bookworm-slim base tag to an immutable linux/amd64 digest before Dockerfile materialization and records that digest in DELIVERY_BUILD_IDENTITY_V1; the build then uses only the digest. The clean operator host requires only a Docker/Compose-compatible engine plus configured network access. Host Node, npm, Git and a repository checkout are not prerequisites.

D4 — The supported CLI commands are exactly doctor, configure, run, status, cancel, backup, restore and upgrade-check. Upgrade and rollback themselves are operator/runbook procedures: upgrade-check + backup + verified local image/bundle switch + doctor/status; rollback uses the exact prior bundle/image plus restore when schema compatibility requires it. No hidden upgrade/rollback command or second lifecycle authority is introduced.

D5 — Configuration is schema-validated and split from secrets. The committed config example contains no credentials; provider/SCM secrets enter only through named environment/file secret inputs. doctor fails with actionable typed errors for missing credentials, unsupported runtime, unreachable SCM/provider prerequisites and incompatible persisted state.

D6 — Clean install is self-contained: the release bundle must include delivery-image.tar, digest-pinned release/config/reference-seed manifests and the runbook. Installation verifies the archive hash, loads the image, verifies the loaded image content ID, and runs Compose with pull disabled. A registry may later mirror the same image but is not part of BB-073 acceptance and cannot be a hidden prerequisite.

D7 — Upgrade procedure is allowed only after CLI upgrade-check validates state-schema compatibility and either no ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempt exists or the exact delivered compatibility contract permits continuation. The procedure then creates/validates backup evidence, loads/verifies the target local bundle/image, switches the operator release directory, and requires doctor/status before use. Otherwise it fails closed; no best-effort migration from unknown state.

D8 — Rollback procedure uses the exact prior release bundle and imageContentId. It switches back only after identity verification and restores the pre-upgrade backup when current persisted state is not downgrade-compatible; doctor/status must succeed against the restored/current canonical state before the rollback is considered complete.

D9 — OpenHands software-agent-sdk v1.49.6 is not repackaged as a second product; the distribution consumes the exact BB-070/BB-069 delivered runtime profile. Langfuse v4.46.0 remains optional observability infrastructure from BB-072 and is not required for install/health.

D10 — Worker preflight requires BB-070 and BB-072 DONE and binds their exact lifecycle/operator/config/state compatibility outputs. Any mismatch in control commands, canonical data roots or compatibility semantics is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-070 DONE: exact supported product-entry/lifecycle/reference-product API and release identity consumed by the distribution.
BB-072 DONE: exact operator CLI/API, canonical store roots, backup/restore contract and state-schema compatibility metadata consumed by install/upgrade/rollback.

implementationSlices: S0 [AC-1, AC-2, AC-3] Preflight dependency bind. Require BB-070 and BB-072 DONE, resolve their exact implementation-result/judgment/consolidated refs and public lifecycle/operations exports, then implement only `packages/delivery-cli/src/dependency-adapter.js` over that exact seam. Run `cli-contract`. Any missing/incompatible public seam returns PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before S1; Worker may not invent an alternate dependency API.

S1 [AC-1, INV-1] Workspace/package/lock + CLI test harness. Create `packages/delivery-cli/package.json`, root `package-lock.json`, and `packages/delivery-cli/test/cli.test.js`. Package is private ESM with fixed bin/export and Node >=24 <25; its dependency version is copied from S0 exact binding. Generate lock with `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`; tests prove local workspace resolution, fixed command surface and no direct canonical-state writes. Run `cli-contract` + `pack`.

S2 [AC-1, INV-2] Config/release schemas + distribution test harness. Create `distribution/config.schema.json`, secret-free `config.example.json`, `reference-seed.json`, `release-manifest.schema.json`, `packages/delivery-cli/src/release.js`, and `test/delivery/bb-073.test.mjs`. Resolve the selected official Node-24 bookworm-slim linux/amd64 base to one immutable digest and bind it with sourceSha/workspaceLockDigest/configSchemaDigest/referenceSeedDigest/stateSchemaCompatibilityVersion in DELIVERY_BUILD_IDENTITY_V1; schema/tests reject mutable or missing identity. Run `image-contract` + `distribution-contract`.

S3 [AC-1, AC-2, INV-1] CLI implementation. Create `config.js`, `commands.js`, `index.js`, and `bin/exharness-delivery.mjs` for exactly doctor/configure/run/status/cancel/backup/restore/upgrade-check over dependency-adapter ports. configure emits non-secret config; run returns projectId/runId/releaseRef/outcomeRef/evidenceRefs; direct authority-store imports/writes fail tests. Run `cli-contract`, `doctor`, `boundary-probe`.

S4 [AC-1, INV-2] OCI image. Create `distribution/Dockerfile` FROM the immutable base digest resolved in S2, copy candidate package.json/lock/packages/** only, run `npm ci --omit=dev`, switch to non-root node, and use the fixed delivery-cli entrypoint. Build linux/amd64 locally and record `docker image inspect .Id` as imageContentId. Run `image-contract`.

S5 [AC-1, INV-2] Release assembly. Create `distribution/compose.yaml` and `scripts/delivery/build-release.mjs --mode build|verify`. Build emits the exact bundle files declared by DELIVERY_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 including delivery-image.tar/runbook, hashes every file, and forbids Compose build sections or required registry pulls; verify works from bundle bytes alone. Run `release-build` + `distribution-contract`.

S6 [AC-1] Fresh-host reference delivery. Implement `scripts/delivery/bb-073-probe.mjs --mode clean-install`: create empty temp host dir, copy only bundle bytes, verify, docker image load, match imageContentId, supply documented external secrets, then doctor -> exact BB-070 reference run -> status with `--pull never --rm`. Persist raw stdout/stderr/exit plus bundle/image/config/run/release/outcome/evidence refs. Any checkout/host Node/npm/Git/registry pull/NOT_RUN/missing accepted outcome fails. Run `clean-install` + `live-probe`.

S7 [AC-2] Typed health negatives in `bb-073-probe.mjs`: MISSING_CREDENTIAL, UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME and INCOMPATIBLE_STATE each fail before run/upgrade mutation with actionable remediation; assert canonical state unchanged. Run `doctor`, `distribution-contract`, `boundary-probe`.

S8 [AC-3] Upgrade-gate/operator-switch exercise in `bb-073-probe.mjs`: build the predeclared RC0/V1 pair from the same executable source with immutable release metadata only; seed RC0 state; QUIESCENT_COMPATIBLE must pass upgrade-check, backup, target bundle/image verification, release-directory switch, doctor/status; ACTIVE_BLOCKED and SCHEMA_BLOCKED stop before switch. Run `upgrade-rollback`.

S9 [AC-3] Rollback/restore exercise in `bb-073-probe.mjs`: verify/load the exact RC0 bundle/imageContentId, switch to prior release directory, restore the pre-upgrade backup only when downgrade compatibility requires it, then require doctor/status and bind restored canonical identity. Claim only v1 mechanics/gating. Run `upgrade-rollback` + `boundary-probe`.

S10 [AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, INV-1, INV-2, INV-3] Closure. Run full CLI/distribution/package/repository regressions and scan Dockerfile/compose/bundle for checkout paths, host Node/npm/Git, secrets, build sections, registry dependency and mutable-image authority. Create/update `docs/runbooks/supported-delivery-profile.md` and `docs/living/system/state.md` with exact install/command/state/error/upgrade/rollback boundaries. Run `repository`.
